metadata.question: Was nightime brightness around the Aswan High Dam higher than the Grand Ethopian Renaissance Dam in 2016?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Night-time brightness = VIIRS DNB. Collection: NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG. Date = 2016, full year median composite. Location: two points: Aswan High Dam (24.21, 32.88) and Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD) ~11.21, 35.09). 2. Masking: VIIRS DNB already cloud-masked; no extra mask needed. 3. Logic: compute 2016 median at each dam, compare the two numbers. - If either collection is empty → C1. - If valid-pixel count after reduceRegion is 0 → C2. - If result is None/NaN → C3. - Else if Aswan > GERD → A, else → B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time aswan = ee.Geometry.Point(32.88, 24.21) gerd = ee.Geometry.Point(35.09, 11.21) start, end = '2016-01-01', '2017-01-01' # 2. Data Acquisition & Check col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') \ .filterDate(start, end) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No 2016 VIIRS images.") print("C1") # 3. Processing img2016 = col.median() # 4. Calculation def bright(p): return img2016.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=p, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo() aw = bright(aswan) gr = bright(gerd) # 5. Validation & Answer if aw is None or gr is None: print("C3") else: print(f"Aswan: {aw:.3f}, GERD: {gr:.3f}") print("A" if aw > gr else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
aswan = ee.Geometry.Point(32.88, 24.21)
gerd  = ee.Geometry.Point(35.09, 11.21)
start, end = '2016-01-01', '2017-01-01'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') \
          .filterDate(start, end)
if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No 2016 VIIRS images.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 3. Processing
img2016 = col.median()

# 4. Calculation
def bright(p):
    return img2016.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=p,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad').getInfo()

aw = bright(aswan)
gr = bright(gerd)

# 5. Validation & Answer
if aw is None or gr is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Aswan: {aw:.3f}, GERD: {gr:.3f}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if aw > gr else "<answer>B</answer>")
